description: Large-scale Spotify track dataset covering 1.18M tracks across six decades. Combines raw Spotify audio features with engineered mood, affect, sonic identity, artist-level, and decade-trend signals for recommendation, hit prediction, genre classification, and longitudinal music analysis.

schema.name: track_id
schema.description: Full Spotify URI for the track (e.g. spotify:track:...)

schema.name: spotify_id
schema.description: Bare Spotify track ID (22-character base-62 string)

schema.name: title
schema.description: Original track title as returned by the Spotify API

schema.name: track_artist
schema.description: Primary artist name

schema.name: release_year
schema.description: Four-digit release year; precision flag in release_year_precision_aug

schema.name: duration_ms
schema.description: Track duration in milliseconds

schema.name: energy
schema.description: Perceptual intensity and activity; 0.0 (calm) to 1.0 (intense). Dataset mean: 0.641

schema.name: valence
schema.description: Musical positiveness; 1.0 = euphoric, 0.0 = sad or tense. Dataset mean: 0.457

schema.name: danceability
schema.description: Suitability for dancing based on tempo, rhythm stability, and beat strength. Dataset mean: 0.540

schema.name: acousticness
schema.description: Confidence that the track is acoustic; values near 1.0 indicate no electronic amplification. Dataset mean: 0.319

schema.name: instrumentalness
schema.description: Predicted absence of vocals; values above 0.5 are treated as likely instrumental

schema.name: speechiness
schema.description: Detects spoken-word content; high values indicate podcasts, comedy, or audiobooks

schema.name: liveness
schema.description: Detects audience presence; values above 0.8 strongly suggest a live recording

schema.name: loudness
schema.description: Overall track loudness; used in energy_loudness_ratio and loudness_war_index

schema.name: tempo
schema.description: Estimated beats per minute. Dataset mean: 121.4 BPM

schema.name: key
schema.description: Pitch class integer (0=C, 1=C#, ..., 11=B) using standard Pitch Class notation

schema.name: key_name
schema.description: Human-readable key name (e.g. C, C#, D)

schema.name: mode
schema.description: Modality; 1 = major (63%), 0 = minor (37%)

schema.name: genre_l1
schema.description: Top-level genre category; 17 values including Electronic, Rock, Pop, Metal, Latin, Classical, Folk, R&B, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Blues, Country, Reggae, Gospel, World, Soundtrack, Instrumental

schema.name: genre_l2
schema.description: Subgenre label; 99 unique values (e.g. Ambient, Alt-Rock, K-Pop, Black Metal, Forró, Dancehall)

schema.name: genre_raw
schema.description: Original Spotify genre tag string retained verbatim

schema.name: track_popularity
schema.description: Spotify popularity score 0–100. Dataset mean: 18.7, median: 15.0; ~4,878 tracks score ≥70

schema.name: streams_total
schema.description: Total estimated stream count. Median: 3.38M, max: 1.59B

schema.name: streams_total_estimated
schema.description: True if streams_total was modelled rather than directly sourced

schema.name: stream_density
schema.description: Streams normalised by track_age_days; measures streaming momentum

schema.name: chart_peak_position
schema.description: Highest chart position achieved; present for ~14,900 charting tracks, null otherwise

schema.name: weeks_on_chart
schema.description: Total weeks the track appeared on tracked charts; null for non-charting tracks

schema.name: track_age_days
schema.description: Days elapsed since release_date at dataset generation time

schema.name: decade
schema.description: Release decade as integer (e.g. 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)

schema.name: emotional_arc
schema.description: Valence × energy quadrant: Q1_euphoric, Q2_angry, Q3_depressed, Q4_content

schema.name: tempo_band
schema.description: BPM bin: very_slow, slow, medium, fast, very_fast

schema.name: mood_index
schema.description: Continuous composite of valence and energy

schema.name: acoustic_synthetic_ratio
schema.description: Acousticness relative to energy; separates organic from electronically produced sound

schema.name: energy_loudness_ratio
schema.description: Normalised loudness relative to energy; captures loudness-war dynamics

schema.name: loudness_war_index
schema.description: Derived measure of dynamic compression; higher values indicate more compressed masters

schema.name: is_likely_instrumental
schema.description: True when instrumentalness exceeds the instrumental classification threshold

schema.name: is_likely_live
schema.description: True when liveness exceeds the live recording classification threshold

schema.name: is_likely_spoken_word
schema.description: True when speechiness indicates primarily spoken-word content

schema.name: novelty_score
schema.description: How sonically distinct the track is relative to its genre's typical audio profile

schema.name: hit_probability
schema.description: Composite score estimating hit likelihood from audio features and popularity signals

schema.name: mood_cluster
schema.description: KMeans-derived mood archetype: happy_energetic, angry_intense, melancholic, sad_slow, calm_positive

schema.name: taste_cluster
schema.description: Listener taste segment assignment; sparse — populated for a small subset of tracks

schema.name: fp_energy
schema.description: Energy component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_valence
schema.description: Valence component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_danceability
schema.description: Danceability component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_acousticness
schema.description: Acousticness component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_instrumentalness
schema.description: Instrumentalness component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_speechiness
schema.description: Speechiness component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: fp_liveness
schema.description: Liveness component of the 7-dimensional sonic fingerprint vector

schema.name: mean_energy_by_artist
schema.description: Artist's characteristic energy level averaged across their catalog in-dataset

schema.name: sonic_evolution_score
schema.description: Measures how much the artist's audio profile has shifted over their career

schema.name: genre_breadth
schema.description: Number of distinct L2 subgenres represented in the artist's catalog

schema.name: catalog_size
schema.description: Total number of tracks attributed to the artist in this dataset

schema.name: career_start_year
schema.description: Year of the artist's earliest release in this dataset

schema.name: career_end_year
schema.description: Year of the artist's most recent release in this dataset

schema.name: career_span_years
schema.description: Years between career_start_year and career_end_year

schema.name: longevity_score
schema.description: Composite of career span, catalog size, and continued chart presence

schema.name: hit_rate
schema.description: Proportion of the artist's tracks exceeding the high-popularity threshold

schema.name: artist_stream_mean_log
schema.description: Log-transformed mean stream count across all of the artist's tracks

schema.name: artist_stream_median_log
schema.description: Log-transformed median stream count across all of the artist's tracks

schema.name: mean_energy_by_decade
schema.description: Population mean energy for all tracks in the same release decade

schema.name: mean_valence_by_decade
schema.description: Population mean valence for all tracks in the same release decade

schema.name: mean_tempo_by_decade
schema.description: Population mean tempo for all tracks in the same release decade

schema.name: mean_loudness_by_decade
schema.description: Population mean loudness for all tracks in the same release decade

schema.name: acousticness_decline_idx
schema.description: Measures the documented cross-decade decline in acoustic recording; higher = more acoustic relative to decade baseline

schema.name: danceability_trend
schema.description: Directional trend in danceability from the artist's earliest to latest release decade

schema.name: decade_track_count
schema.description: Number of tracks in this dataset from the same release decade

schema.name: anomaly_flags
schema.description: Pipe-delimited anomaly type labels. Values: LIKELY_PODCAST_OR_AUDIOBOOK, LIKELY_CLIPPED, EXTREME_DURATION, LIKELY_SILENT_TRACK, GENRE_AUDIO_MISMATCH. Empty string if no anomaly

schema.name: has_anomaly
schema.description: True if any anomaly flag is set; ~21,400 tracks flagged (~1.8% of dataset)

schema.name: popularity_imputed_aug
schema.description: True if track_popularity was imputed rather than directly sourced

schema.name: release_year_precision_aug
schema.description: True if release_year was inferred at year precision rather than from a full release_date
